text:
anna-sales: AcmeHealth POC failing right before demo — getting 403 'invalid_org_claim' then some 429s. tagging eng & support. @tom-se @lucy-eng

acme-ops: Repro: server proxied request to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate with Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_ABC. Response: {"error":"invalid_org_claim","message":"request missing org binding"} After ~5 quick retries we saw 429.

tom-se: likely project-scoped key hitting org endpoint OR proxy stripping X-ORG-ID. Can you paste proxied headers (redact tokens)?

acme-ops: proxy logs: Authorization, User-Agent: acme-proxy/1.0, X-Project-ID: proj-42. No X-ORG-ID — our proxy normalizes headers.

lucy-eng: confirms: project-bound key + org endpoint = invalid_org_claim. Two options: (a) switch to project-scoped endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-42/generate or (b) have proxy inject X-ORG-ID header or (c) use an org-scoped key.

edith-support: 429s came from client retrier flooding. SDK v2.1.4 uses linear retries by default; enable exponential backoff or honor Retry-After. Also set REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 to capture response headers (x-request-id, x-rw-retry) for our traces.

acme-ops: we can't rotate keys for demo. Preferred quick fix?

lucy-eng: temp fix without rotation: update proxy target to project-scoped route. Example: ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_ABC" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/proj-42/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"test"}'```

tom-se: note for security questionnaire: token binding semantics: project-scoped keys can only access project routes; org-scoped keys can access org-level routes. Tokens include binding claims (org/project) and the service enforces them at the gateway. Recommend short TTLs and rotation for demos.

julia-ps: sales can issue a short-lived org-scoped trial key (24h) if you prefer keeping the org endpoint; I will request approval from sales-ops now. Pricing note: trial project keys inherit sandbox quotas; for bursty demo traffic we can open a small burst window on a case-by-case basis.

deploy-bot: [infra] detected 6x 403->retry->429 pattern from ip 18.204.12.7, auto-throttled.

acme-ops: changed proxy to project route and added jitter/backoff; tests now OK, 200 and generation payloads returned. Thanks!

anna-sales: please post the 1-paragraph security blurb and recommended dev checklist (endpoint, SDK version, backoff) — acme needs it for their questionnaire.

julia-ps: drafting now, will post in 10m.

edith-support: opened SUP-12901 with logs & mitigation steps. Marking P0 for the demo window and cc'ing sales-ops.

acme-ops: demo is green from our side — appreciate the quick help.
